questions.question: How many customers are from India?
List all products with fewer than 30 units in stock
Which customer has placed the highest number of orders?
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT c.name AS customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

questions.question: What is the mean total amount spent per order?
questions.generated_sql:
SELECT AVG(total_spent) AS mean_total_spent_per_order
FROM (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total_spent
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
) AS order_totals;
